title: Evil and Epic Cats
description: A mod which adds some good and bad cats!
body:
# 📖 What does this mod add to my game?
**When it comes down to free homes or epic friends, this mod adds just that! Explore the Good Cats biome to tame some furry friends and get some houses! Watch out for the Evil Cats biome though, they aren't very nice to their visitors. Look out for the Cat Gem ore which gives you cat armor! Purrfect for your adventures! Make sure to not get attacked with tyhe Cat Infected potion! Its very very bad for you!**

# 🐈 Why should I download this?
**Its simple, its for your own entertainment and fun! Also just for fun why not have war with the evil cats?**

# 🖥️ Do I need a client like Optifine or Sodium?
**Sodium or Optifine are not required for this mod to load and work**
